question: What source address does one request through an AnchoredIP lease actually return, and does it differ from extras.rung=3?
why: unverified: behind a sign-up. The keyless API (GET /api/plans/, GET /api/) answers but echoes no caller address; obtaining an address requires ordering a trial with a billing email and bringing up a WireGuard tunnel on a machine. The vendor documents an exit check but no keyless endpoint reveals the exit. No exit address was observed, so the rung stays at the measured registration class of the subnet.
